title: Two days in Tay Ninh
summary: Stand for the noon service at the Holy See, stay for the 18:00 service if the night is in this court, and ride the cable at Ba Den the next morning.

days.title: Day 1 — The court and the 18:00 service
days.body: Stand for the noon service at the Holy See in Long Hoa, shoes off, men at the right door and women at the left. Stay for the 18:00 service if the night is in this court.

days.title: Day 2 — The cable
days.body: Ride the cable at Ba Den, a little more than 10 km or 11 km northeast of the city. How long you stay on the mountain is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Cao Dai Holy See
stops.note: Stand for the noon service for about 60 minutes, with shoes off and men and women at separate doors.

stops.name: Ba Den Mountain
stops.note: Ride the summit cable and the temple line, and give the mountain most of a day.

additions.name: Banh canh Trang Bang
additions.note: Eat a bowl in khu phố Gia Huỳnh if you stop in Trảng Bàng on the way in.

additions.name: Banh trang phoi suong
additions.note: Eat a rice-paper roll in Trảng Bàng on the way in.

seoTitle: Two days in Tay Ninh — Holy See noon, then the cable
seoDescription: A Tay Ninh night for the Cao Dai noon service, about 60 minutes in the hall, and the Ba Den cable the next morning.
